about: Every line video-ambient-loop says or sends: the customer's chat lines, the sentences scripts/loop_decide.py assembles into the picture, clip and music prompts, and the fix-table clauses. All are SL8 wording: they restate Everygen's Rain and ambient lines (no licence stated, so restated, never copied; workflow-sources.json everygen copy false) and are cited by research id in `from`. The vendor wrote and tuned them for Seedance 2.5, Nano Banana 2 and Lyria 3.5 in its own app; neither its wording nor these restatements have been run on this machine's models. The chat lines are defaults: a kit or brief may set its own. Square brackets are filled at run time; the copy check (workflow-check.mjs copy) compares each `prompt` with the research prompt in `from`.

rows.use: chat, first output (step 3)
rows.prompt: [the scene in a few plain words], [real and unfiltered, for the real look only], [vertical, wide or square], [the length in words].

rows.use: chat, an example of the plan line
rows.prompt: Night rain on a cosy window seat, vertical, close to two and a half minutes.

rows.use: chat, an example of the plan line in the real look
rows.prompt: Heavy rain over a back garden, real and unfiltered, vertical, about a minute.

rows.use: chat, the three plain steps under the plan line (step 3)
rows.prompt: 1. Build the scene: [scene, a few words] (and the music, when it was asked for). 2. Start the rain falling. 3. Assemble your video.

rows.use: chat, a few words before each paid call
rows.prompt: Preparing the scene:
rows.from: everygen/rainambient-fe45fe@Talking to them (fixed chat lines and banned words)

rows.use: chat, when the picture is back (step 7); never describe the picture
rows.prompt: The scene is ready. Next, the rain starts to fall:

rows.use: chat, alone, once, after the clip call is sent (step 8)
rows.prompt: Give it a few minutes.

rows.use: chat, alone, once, while the video is encoded (step 16)
rows.prompt: Nearly done.

rows.use: chat, alone, before a redo (step 9); then clip-wait
rows.prompt: Once more, so the rain comes out right.

rows.use: chat, the run's closing message (step 17)
rows.prompt: Your [scene, a few words] is ready: [the length in words] of [what the rain falls on and how it sounds], built to play over and over. [One short question offering two or three choices]?

rows.use: chat, the choices the hand-off may offer (step 17)
rows.prompt: another scene; more length, offered only below the longest; a wide frame, offered only for a vertical one; soft piano under the rain, or the rain by itself when music is already in

rows.use: chat, an example hand-off
rows.prompt: Your forest in the rain is ready: about a minute of steady rain on the ferns and mossy stones, built to play over and over. Would you like a wide version, or soft piano under the rain?

rows.use: chat, added to the hand-off when a travelling element was asked for and kept resting
rows.prompt: The mist stays resting in place, so the scene keeps calm every time it plays.

rows.use: chat, added to the hand-off when thunder or lightning was asked for
rows.prompt: Thunder would come back at the same moment every time it plays, so this one has steady rain without it.
rows.notes: From research:everygen/rainambient-fe45fe#113 (a fine point, not a prompt).

rows.use: chat, added to the hand-off when more than the longest length was asked for
rows.prompt: It is built to play again and again, so leave it running as long as you want.

rows.use: chat, in the hand-off when the music failed twice
rows.prompt: The soft piano did not come together this time; I can try it again.

rows.use: chat, when the picture or the clip failed after its retry
rows.prompt: This scene would not come together. Shall I try a different one?

rows.use: chat, when the video could not be put together
rows.prompt: I could not finish your video just now. Shall I try again?

rows.use: chat, added to the hand-off when the clip came from Kling
rows.prompt: This version carries very little rain sound; I can make one where the rain is clearly heard.

rows.use: picture prompt, after the scene's picture and light lines
rows.prompt: The rain shows as bright streaks against a dark background, every wet surface shines, and there is depth from a near object right by the lens out to a distant background. The place is empty, with nobody and no animals in it.
rows.from: everygen/rainambient-fe45fe@What a good one is (target description)

rows.use: picture prompt, film look
rows.prompt: It looks like a frame from a calm, lovely film, with fine grain.
rows.from: everygen/rainambient-fe45fe@What a good one is (target description)

rows.use: picture prompt, real look
rows.prompt: It looks like real, unedited footage: soft natural light, muted true-to-life colour, no filter and no grade.
rows.from: everygen/rainambient-fe45fe@What a good one is (target description)

rows.use: lever for a refused picture or clip: replaces the picture line's people or busy details
rows.prompt: an empty place with nobody in it

rows.use: clip prompt, second sentence (every scene but the car and snowy windows)
rows.prompt: Falling rain shows as bright streaks from start to finish.

rows.use: clip prompt, second sentence for the car window (asking for streaks across the frame made the picture roll the window down)
rows.prompt: Drops keep landing on the glass and running down it in thin bright trails from start to finish.
rows.from: everygen/rainambient-fe45fe@Real-look insert and car/snow window note

rows.use: clip prompt, second sentence for the snowy window
rows.prompt: Snow keeps falling past the glass in soft bright flakes from start to finish.
rows.from: everygen/rainambient-fe45fe@Real-look insert and car/snow window note

rows.use: clip prompt, after the motion line and the rain sentence; the real-look insert goes right after its third sentence
rows.prompt: The shot is fixed on a tripod, with no panning, tilting, zooming or shaking; every bit of movement comes from the rain. It plays at normal speed, never slowed down or sped up. Only the rain moves the place: it stays empty of people and animals, nothing smokes or steams, nothing comes into view or goes out of it, and the light holds even.

rows.use: clip prompt, after the body (and the real-look insert)
rows.prompt: Sound: [sound line from the scene row], kept at one soft, steady volume from beginning to end and finishing as quietly as it starts.

rows.use: clip prompt, last sentence
rows.prompt: The downpour keeps one even strength throughout, and the final frame matches the opening frame exactly, so it repeats with no visible seam.

rows.use: clip prompt, real look only, right after 'and the light holds even.'; never the word phone
rows.prompt: Unprocessed look: true exposure, fine natural sensor noise, soft real-world colour, no grading.
rows.from: everygen/rainambient-fe45fe@Real-look insert and car/snow window note

rows.use: motion line clause with trees in view (keeps gusts out of picture and sound)
rows.prompt: in windless air

rows.use: motion line clause when a travelling element (mist, fog, cloud) was asked for
rows.prompt: a layer of mist lying low and settled among the trees

rows.use: music prompt (step 6); with fal-ai/elevenlabs/music the bracket is dropped and music_length_ms is set
rows.prompt: A soft, low solo piano with a muffled felt tone, airy and unhurried, instrumental only, played as one unbroken piece of [the track length in words], never pausing or stopping.

rows.use: fix: rain too loud (re-film with the scene's sound line made softer, surfaces kept); window seat example
rows.prompt: light rain tapping softly on the tall window glass and the wooden roof overhead
rows.from: everygen/rainambient-fe45fe@Fix line: rain too loud (window seat, stitch route)

rows.use: fix: rain too soft (re-film with the sound line made heavier, surfaces kept); window seat example
rows.prompt: a heavy downpour beating close against the tall window glass and drumming on the wooden roof
rows.from: everygen/rainambient-fe45fe@Fix line: rain too soft (window seat)

rows.use: fix: a visible jump at the restart point (re-film, naming the moving thing coming back to rest)
rows.prompt: the pine branches rock and come to rest in the very place they began

rows.use: fix: rain too faint in daylight (new picture with less sky)
rows.prompt: a dark row of trees and the walls of the house fill the view behind the falling rain
rows.from: everygen/rainambient-fe45fe@Fix line: faint rain in daylight

rows.use: fix: too dark (new picture, same look, stronger light line; never turn dusk or night into day)
rows.prompt: the lamp casts its glow across the window ledge and pane

rows.use: fix: too glossy in the film look (new picture, softer contrast, more haze)
rows.prompt: shot on 35mm stock, fine grain
rows.from: everygen/rainambient-fe45fe@Fix line: too glossy, film look

rows.use: fix: too glossy in the real look (new picture; never the words film look)
rows.prompt: honest exposure, faint natural sensor noise, subdued colours, no gloss anywhere
rows.from: everygen/rainambient-fe45fe@Fix line: too glossy, real look

rows.use: fix: something appears (re-film; the camera sentence unchanged; the place named as staying empty, phrased positively)
rows.prompt: the street stays empty the whole time

rows.use: fix: rain or leaves hardly move (re-film with the moves made concrete, nothing shrunk)
rows.prompt: each leaf jumps and sinks under the drops and springs straight back up

rows.use: fix: a flat, featureless rain sound (re-film, naming the nearest surface)
rows.prompt: drops tapping right up close on the window glass and the ledge
